policy.content:
================================================================================
                          COMPANY POLICY TERMS
================================================================================
Company Name:   [Insert Company Name]
Effective Date: [Insert Date]
Version:        1.0
Applies To:     All employees, contractors, and interns
================================================================================

1. PURPOSE AND ACCEPTANCE
These Company Policy Terms establish core workplace expectations and rules. By
working with or representing [Insert Company Name], you agree to follow these
terms and all applicable local laws.

2. CODE OF CONDUCT
- Treat colleagues, clients, and partners with respect, honesty, and fairness.
- Zero tolerance for discrimination, harassment, bullying, or retaliation.
- Avoid conflicts of interest and disclose potential conflicts promptly to
  management or Human Resources.

3. ATTENDANCE AND WORK HOURS
- Maintain regular working hours and meet agreed schedules or deliverables.
- Request planned time off in advance through the approved process.
- Notify your manager as early as possible if you are sick or face an
  unexpected absence.

4. CONFIDENTIALITY AND DATA SECURITY
- Keep proprietary business data, client records, trade secrets, and login
  credentials confidential during and after employment.
- Use company devices, email, and software responsibly and only for approved
  work purposes.
- Report any lost devices, suspicious links, or data breaches immediately to
  IT or security support.

5. POLICY UPDATES AND COMPLIANCE
- [Insert Company Name] may update or revise these terms as needed and will
  notify affected personnel of material changes.
- Violations of these policy terms may result in disciplinary action, up to and
  including termination of employment or contract, as permitted by law.

6. QUESTIONS AND REPORTING
If you have questions about these terms or need to report a concern, contact
[Insert HR / Compliance Contact Email or Department].
================================================================================
